text:
maria.chen: Heads-up — staging perf dashboard spiked after the nightly deploy that included the checkpoint rollup (#5123). 90th p50 token latency +22% on long prompts, and KV cache hit-rate dropped ~18%.

sam.garcia: ugh. seeing same in CI perf run for PR 5342, pipeline perf test failed with timeout on serve-smoke. stacktrace points at kernel fallback for attention on cuda.

jordan.liu: I profiled a canary yesterday. Kernel selector switched from fused_attn_fast -> generic_attn when seq_len > 1024. New tokenizer seems to emit extra BOS-like marker that increases effective sequence length for some inputs.

cassie_rice: repro snippet I ran:
```
./bin/perf_run --model redwood-v2-rollup --prompt-file tests/long_prompts.txt --profile nvprof
# saw 40% more memcpy and generic kernel invocations
```

maria.chen: interesting — so it's not pure kernel perf but the tokenizer change created longer sequences -> different kernel path + worse KV reuse because prefix boundaries shifted.

jordan.liu: ran KV cache instrumented build: cache hit-rate drops on ~30% of traces where tokenization splits differently. Patch that added the extra token was in PR 5123: `tokenizer: preserve_specials=true`.

sam.garcia: can we bisect to the exact merge? I started `git bisect` across merges since last green and the culprit is 94f2c7a (tokenizer preserve_specials). Reverting locally brings latency back to baseline.

maria.chen: ok please open a revert PR with benchmark numbers. Also add a short-term fallback in kernel selector to avoid switching to generic_attn when KV hit-rate is expected to stay high.

cassie_rice: opened revert: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/5410 — includes perf traces and nvprof snippets. will run canary after merge.

ci-bot: Perf test rerun queued for branch revert-5410. Estimated run time ~18m.

ops-bot: Canary deploy scheduled to `staging` at 2026-02-15T03:20Z after CI green :thumbsup:

sam.garcia: after revert canary, 50/90p latency back to baseline and KV hit-rate restored. leaving follow-up issue to rework tokenizer + add a compatibility flag so rollout doesn't change prefixing behavior: ISSUE-1297.

maria.chen: great job. follow-up: add unit tests for prefix-preservation and a perf guard in CI so similar regressions trigger an automatic reviewer ping. :rocket:
